name: The Oakwood, Esher
summary: Learn to ski or practise existing skills on one of Surrey's few dry ski slopes. The Oakwood offers private coaching, group lessons, a junior ski club, recreational skiing and seasonal ski camps, plus high ropes, Ringo rides and laser tag.
reasonToVisit: A dry ski slope with lessons, high ropes and laser tag on one site
planningDetail: Book the appropriate lesson or session and check age, ability and clothing requirements
